items.name: platform-badge
items.title: Platform Badge
items.description: A small label naming a social platform (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Threads) with a color dot. Props: platform, label?, plus all Badge props.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: One headline number with an optional up/down change. Props: label, value, formatValue?, change? (fraction, 0.12 = +12%), changeLabel?, hint?, icon?, className?.

items.name: challenge-progress
items.title: Challenge Progress
items.description: "Day 37 of 90" card with time and goal progress bars and an ahead/on-pace/behind label. Props: day, totalDays? (90), title?, goal? { label, current, target, start?, formatValue? }, className?. Also exports paceStatus().

items.name: challenge-chart
items.title: Challenge Chart
items.description: The 90-day challenge graph (Recharts): actual progress against a dashed straight line to the goal, with milestone and Today markers. Props: data [{ day, value }], goal, totalDays? (90), startValue?, today?, milestones? [{ day, label }], valueLabel?, formatValue?, className?.

items.name: stat-card-demo
items.title: Stat Card example
items.description: Example usage of stat-card: three cards with changes, an icon and a hint.

items.title: Challenge Progress example
items.description: Example usage of challenge-progress with a follower goal.
